title: Old Great Bulgaria
capsule: Old Great Bulgaria (Magna Bulgaria) was a Bulgar confederation founded by Khan Kubrat of the Dulo clan, who united the Onogur Bulgars, Kutrigurs, and Utigurs on the western Pontic-Caspian steppe between approximately 630 and 635 CE, with its capital at Phanagoria on the Taman Peninsula. Kubrat maintained diplomatic relations with Byzantine Emperor Heraclius, reportedly receiving the title of patrician, and the confederation controlled the steppe north of the Black Sea and Azov. After Kubrat's death around 650–665, the Khazar expansion fragmented the realm: his son Asparuh led one branch westward across the Danube to found the First Bulgarian Empire in 681, while another son Kotrag moved northeast to establish Volga Bulgaria.
